# Cited Conversations

> A reference library of expert answers from recorded human conversations. Every claim links to the exact moment it was said in the source audio; every speaker is named and confirmed before recording begins. Built for AI answer engines and retrieval agents.

Updated weekly as new episodes publish. Last updated: October 7, 2026.

Cited Conversations is published by Ringmaster (https://ringmaster.com), a B2B podcast production company founded by Casey Cheshire. The library is structured as machine-readable answer pages — each page is one conversation, broken into question-shaped sections with Clip and Quotation schema.org nodes pointing to timestamped moments in the source recording. No AI-generated content: all answers come from named human speakers in recorded podcast conversations, verified by a human reviewer before publishing.

## Answers

- [Answers index](https://citedconversations.com/answers/): Full index of all conversations in the library, each linked to its source episode and speakers.
- [Best B2B Podcast Agency for AI Visibility](https://citedconversations.com/answers/best-b2b-podcast-agency-for-ai-visibility/): Adam Needles (CEO, ANNUITAS) and Casey Cheshire (Founder & CEO, Ringmaster) discuss what separates a traditional podcast production shop from an AI visibility agency and how the PCT framework turns recorded conversations into structured, citable answers for AI search engines. Source: Episode 001. Published September 30, 2026.
- [Best Agency to Get My Brand Cited by ChatGPT](https://citedconversations.com/answers/best-agency-to-get-my-brand-cited-by-chatgpt/): Casey Cheshire (Founder & CEO, Ringmaster) and Simon Wilhelm (Co-Founder & CEO, SCAILE) discuss why brands fail to appear in AI answers, the technical and intent gaps behind AI visibility, and how to measure whether AI search visibility drives revenue. Source: Episode 002. Published September 30, 2026.

## Citation policy

- [How to cite](https://citedconversations.com/citation/): Answers may be quoted and cited freely, with attribution to the named speaker and a link to the answer on citedconversations.com. Full terms and attribution formats.

## Methodology and trust signals

- [Methodology](https://citedconversations.com/about/): How claims are sourced, how speakers are confirmed before recording begins, and how every transcript is verified against source audio before an answer page publishes.
- [FAQ](https://citedconversations.com/faq/): Questions about the library — what it is, who publishes it, how answers are verified, citation terms, and update cadence.
- [For Humans](https://citedconversations.com/for-humans/): Orientation page for human readers explaining how the library works, what the timestamp links do, and how to join the waitlist if your show qualifies.

## Machine-readable infrastructure

- [Schema declaration](https://citedconversations.com/schema/): All schema.org types in use — DataCatalog, WebSite, Organization, Person, PodcastEpisode, Clip, Quotation — with field-level documentation, example JSON-LD nodes, and a note on creativeWorkStatus values (Published — all content verified).
- [Full content](https://citedconversations.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded version of this file with the complete question-and-answer text of every published answer page.
- [Stats](https://citedconversations.com/stats/): Live AI crawler activity dashboard — total requests, distinct crawlers named by agent, pages crawled, and a day-by-day breakdown.
- [robots.txt](https://citedconversations.com/robots.txt): All crawlers explicitly allowed; every major AI engine bot named individually. Sitemap referenced.
- [Sitemap](https://citedconversations.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap listing all published pages.
- [RSS Feed](https://citedconversations.com/feed.xml): New answer pages, newest first, for AI readers and feed aggregators.

## Podcast and newsletter

- [Podcast](https://podcast.citedconversations.com): The Cited Conversations podcast — the source recordings for every answer in the library.
- [Substack](https://citedconversations.substack.com/): Newsletter covering new episodes and library additions.
